items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] With Ripley. Ripley, Ripley. Yeah. Man, he got so big nobody couldn't say anything to him.

ctx.x: And that's, that's, that's where the lawyers, you see? You see this lady take a little one blow. He had no business in the world quitting Duke. One of the greatest bands you can get in. Can't get no higher than that. Man wrote up, he's making so many notes a minute. He'll show you the thing every time you see him clip them.
With Ripley. Ripley, Ripley. Yeah. Man, he got so big nobody couldn't say anything to him.

See, you don't let the, see I got writers all to a man. I got, see, everything he has writers from different part of the country. France. I got books. I got a book over there in France. We'll let you read me some French after a while. All right. See, never, never let none of those things, nothing like that go there. People say, Jesus Christ, man, thanks very much. I'm glad you like it. See? And I'm gone. What do you think about it? You like playing music? I said, no, I don't want to do nothing. Well, I ain't…
